meta.name: scienceworld-container-item-retriever
meta.description: This skill retrieves a specified item from a container by using the 'pick up' action. It should be triggered when the agent has identified a needed item inside an open container (e.g., a jar, box, or hive) and must transfer it to inventory for later use. The skill handles the object transfer, assuming the container is already accessible, and outputs confirmation that the item is now in the agent's inventory.

copy.tagline: 从容器中取出指定物品放入背包
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在游戏或模拟环境中从容器中拾取物品。
copy.tagline_en: Retrieve a specified item from a container into inventory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pick up items from containers in a game or simulation.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，当你让Claude从已经打开的容器（如罐子、盒子）里拿某个物品时，它会执行“拾取”动作，把物品放进自己的背包，并告诉你物品已成功拿到。
howto.when: 当Claude发现需要的物品在已经打开的容器内，并且你的目标是把它拿到手里或背包里时触发。

say.text: 从罐子里拿出鳄梨种子。
say.note: Claude会执行拾取动作并报告成功。

say.text: 把盒子里的螺丝刀递给我。
say.note: 物品会进入背包，可用于后续步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask Claude to retrieve a specific item from an already open container (e.g., jar, box), it will use the 'pick up' action to transfer the item into its inventory and confirm the result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude has identified a needed item inside an open container and your goal is to possess it for later use.

say_en.text: Pick up the avocado seed from the jar.
say_en.note: Claude executes pick up and confirms success.

say_en.text: Take the screwdriver out of the box.
say_en.note: Item moves to inventory for later tasks.
